review.notes: Full word-level diff of the OCR markdown against extracted text from all 49 physical PDF pages (case/punctuation/hyphen-insensitive); physical pages 4, 5, 31, 32, 33, 34, 35, 36, 40 and 48 were rendered at 115 dpi and pages 37 and 49 additionally at 300 dpi crops to verify every patch. No code fences exist in the source, so no fence-balance damage. All 17 numbered footnote markers survive while every footnote body was dropped; the bodies are restored after the paragraphs carrying their markers, in printed page order. Five introduction bullet heads were promoted to level-2 headings by OCR and are demoted back to list text. The print's own misspellings ("mains characteristics", "intented", "devasted", "Welsch") are preserved; two of them had been silently auto-corrected by OCR and are restored. Language names flagged missing on physical page 32 are the rotated x-axis labels inside the embedded Figure 16 image (not a defect); the same applies to legend text flagged on pages 8, 11, 15, 24. In-figure banner words like "Feature normalizer" belong to the embedded Figure 4 diagram.
